subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Let x[n] and y[n] be two odd sequences. If z[n] = 
x[n] y[n] and w[n] = x[n] + y[n], then 
 
(a) z[n] is odd and w[n] is even 
 
(b) both z[n] and w[n] are even 
 
(c) z[n] is even and w[n] is odd 
 
(d) both z[n] and w[n] are odd 
Energy Power Signals

options.text: z[n] is odd and w[n] is even
both z[n] and w[n] are even
z[n] is even and w[n] is odd
both z[n] and w[n] are odd

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-08 (Periodic/Aperiodic, Even/odd,).
